visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Give the Digit Loop a Function
visualizerParams.problemDescription: This program works but uses vague names and keeps everything in main. Move the loop into a function with clear names. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A function named digit_sum says what the loop does, can be reused for any number, and its parameter names (number, sum) replace the meaningless a, b, c, d. main now just calls it and prints.
